Expense Policy Section 1. Business travel is reimbursable when it is necessary for approved company activities.
Expense Policy Section 2. Taxi expenses are reimbursable when public transport is unavailable or impractical.
Expense Policy Section 3. Hotel accommodation must be reasonable and must not exceed the approved nightly allowance.
Expense Policy Section 4. Computer equipment purchases require manager approval before the purchase is made.
Expense Policy Section 5. Business meals must have a clear business purpose and include the names of attendees.
Expense Policy Section 6. Office supplies may be purchased within the approved cost centre budget.
Expense Policy Section 7. Air travel should use economy class unless an exception is approved by management.
Expense Policy Section 8. Receipts must include the vendor name, VAT number, transaction date and total amount.
Expense Policy Section 9. Software subscriptions must be approved by the responsible department manager.
Expense Policy Section 10. Rail travel is preferred over air travel for eligible short-distance business journeys.
Expense Policy Section 11. Expenses above the employee's approval limit must be escalated to a higher approver.
Expense Policy Section 12. Accommodation upgrades and personal expenses are not reimbursable.
Expense Policy Section 13. Employees must submit expenses within 30 days of the transaction date.
Expense Policy Section 14. Duplicate expense claims must be rejected and investigated.
Expense Policy Section 15. Purchases must be assigned to the correct company cost centre.
Expense Policy Section 16. Expenses must not exceed the remaining approved budget.
Expense Policy Section 17. A manager may approve expenses only within their delegated authority.
Expense Policy Section 18. Foreign currency expenses must include the original amount and currency.
Expense Policy Section 19. VAT information must be present where required by local tax rules.
Expense Policy Section 20. Expenses with missing supporting documentation may be rejected.
